tldr: North Node in aries: growth through self-direction, courage, and clean initiative.
body: This nodal axis asks the person to develop self-direction, courage, and clean initiative. The South Node in libra shows the familiar route: people-pleasing, over-compromise, and waiting for consensus before acting. The work is not to reject the South Node completely, but to stop letting it run automatically. The North Node becomes stronger through repeated, conscious choices to lead before every room approves.
business: Growth accelerates when the person practices self-direction, courage, and clean initiative in real decisions, relationships, work, and daily habits.
shadow: Under stress, the South Node in libra can pull the person back into people-pleasing, over-compromise, and waiting for consensus before acting.
policy: Read as a nodal axis: North Node sign names the growth medicine; South Node sign names the familiar pattern. Do not treat either node as a planet or deterministic fate.
note: Distilled from approved project node source material. Source files were not copied into the repository.
